model: Each run's estimate of one cell is normal around the same true value; the run's stated 95% interval half-width is 1.96 standard deviations, s = (ln hi - ln lo) / (2 x 1.96); errors are independent between runs. For an ordered pair (A, B) the log difference of the two points has variance s_A^2 + s_B^2. 'outside' is the count the README quotes (A's point outside B's stored [lo, hi]); expected_outside uses B's stored offsets around its point, expected_outside_sym uses 1.96 s_B on both sides. 'pair z' is the difference over its standard deviation (|z| > 1.96 in 5% of pairs, rms 1, if calibrated). Simulation: SIM_REPS draws; 'independent' = one error per (run, cell, column); 'common' = one shared draw per run (all cells of a run move together).
